title: Comorbidity between depression and anxiety: assessing the role of bridge mental states in dynamic psychological networks
limitations: - Group-level analyses may not capture individual differences; - VAR model assumes linear dynamics and fixed lag; - Bridge effects may be more relevant during acute symptom phases not captured in this sample
notes: The study used a preregistered design and made code and data available on OSF. The bridge effect for 'feeling down' was stronger than for 'worrying' in both comorbid and anxiety-only groups, contradicting the hypothesis that overlapping symptoms are stronger bridges.
